2116485346733305876.en_summary: A historically strong seasonal window for the S&P 500 just opened, running from the October 28 close through November 4. Over 77 years, gains of at least 3% have outnumbered comparable losses 15 to 2. It is a tendency, not a promise: 2022 closed this same window down 2.3%. Weight of Evidence: Constructive, selective. Covers U.S. Stocks, France, Seasonal, Discretionary, Silver.
